description: Brought the basket and swore the copying was clean.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Held the sixteen bars, heard Mab, and left Richard alone.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Gave the table and the cushion, and took the blow on the back.
name: James Burbage

description: Kept the half song half, and kept the book shut.
name: John Heminges

description: Marked the roll, asked nothing, and left.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Named his age and the haste, and refused a new speech at the door.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the Nurse, the child, the cushion, and the napkin.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Counted nine-and-twenty, and stayed on you.
name: Will Kemp
